DOHNA_DOHNA_SQUAD_UI.passive_kuma: Kuma and members behind him have 1 additional Strength.
DOHNA_DOHNA_SQUAD_UI.passive_alyce: ALyCE deals 4 additional damage per hit to enemies attacked by another member this turn.

DOHNA_DOHNA_SQUAD_UI.passive_tora: Each turn, each kind of positive effect grants Torataro 1 Strength for that turn, once per kind.
DOHNA_DOHNA_SQUAD_UI.passive_kikuchiyo: After Kikuchiyo performs her first Attack each turn, draw 1 card.
DOHNA_DOHNA_SQUAD_UI.passive_medhico: Each combat, the first member to exchange positions with Medhico heals 3 HP.
DOHNA_DOHNA_SQUAD_UI.passive_joker: Whenever Joker changes position, he gains 2 Vigor.
DOHNA_DOHNA_SQUAD_UI.passive_zappa: At the end of your turn, if Zappa is in front, he gains 4 Block.
DOHNA_DOHNA_SQUAD_UI.passive_kirakira: At the start of each combat, choose a card in your hand. It gains Retain this combat.
DOHNA_DOHNA_SQUAD_UI.passive_porno: Porno and the member directly in front of her have 2 additional Thorns.
